status_summary: HHS and FDA announced Operation Stork Speed on 2025-03-18; among its six actions it extends the FDA's personal importation policy for infant formula and encourages companies to work with the FDA on clearer labeling, and announces no tariff change, foreign standard recognition or labeling rule. The FDA's program page (updated 2026-07-13) says the personal importation policy first put in place in 2022 continues and does not address recognition of foreign standards. Annex II of Executive Order 14360 (2025-11-14), which exempted certain agricultural products from reciprocal tariffs, lists no infant formula entry, and no tariff cut, mutual recognition step or 119th Congress formula tariff bill was found.

timeline.event: HHS and FDA announce Operation Stork Speed, including an extension of the FDA personal importation policy for infant formula and encouragement of labeling transparency; the release announces no tariff change or labeling rule.

title: Liberalize infant formula imports: lower tariffs, loosen labeling, mutual recognition
uncertainties: The HHS release (2025-03-18) and the FDA program page (updated 2026-07-13) were read in earlier reviews, and Annex II of Executive Order 14360 was read in full by the researcher on public-inspection.federalregister.gov; it lists no infant formula or HTS 1901.10 entry. This review ran a Federal Register API query for infant formula and tariff since 2025-01-20, which returned two USDA safeguard trigger notices (2025-12-22 and 2026-09-02) that do not mention formula; the researcher's query for infant formula since 2026-01-01 (36 matches, first 20 titles read) found only information collection notices, a WIC rule and unrelated items. Whether formula faced reciprocal tariffs before Executive Order 14389 ended them on 2026-02-20 (see c26-02) was not confirmed against the tariff schedule. The personal importation policy continues a 2022 policy and concerns personal-use imports, so it is a small parallel step and a reader could stage this not_started. Earlier web searches on formula tariff bills, HHS formula actions and mutual recognition of EU formula returned only 2022 and 2023 material. Nutrient review and WIC bidding are tracked in c10-10.
